source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At Declare Battle Formations, optionally assign the D-cannon Platform to a GUARDIAN DEFENDERS unit on your roster. A recipient may take only one SUPPORT WEAPON model. Add the platform to the unit’s Starting Strength and keep it in that unit through battle end. Embarking in a **TRANSPORT** is prohibited for the platform and the rest of its unit.

attachment.addOwnerModelTo: one Guardian Defenders unit in own army
